title: Actual quotient units commute with transitions
statement: For a prime l, finite E/Q_l, a scheme Y and any unbounded complex P of completed coefficient modules, the actual quotient unit at level n+1 followed by the actual quotient transition to level n equals the actual quotient unit at level n, for every n≥0.

source.place: Clause (2), pullback commutes with reductions, and clause (3), second paragraph: agent-formulated identification of the specified inverse-image comparison with the completion unit. Compare Stacks derived.tex Tag 08TC (definition-derived-limit) and the explicit cone map of def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison (b).

proof.text: Evaluate on each degree and section. Both unit formulas insert 1 tensor x. The uniquely specified quotient transition takes 1 tensor x to 1 tensor x, since its coefficient quotient preserves 1. Extensionality proves the chain-map identity.

proof_origin.place: Clauses (2)–(3), explicit strict quotient augmentation and multiplication cancellation.

lean.statement:
theorem trfStrictQuotientUnit_compatible
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    unrestrictedTowerUnit l E Y P (n + 1) ≫
        (unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E Y n).app P =
      unrestrictedTowerUnit l E Y P n
